title: Dataset
description: A saved, named filter that scopes the hospital database to a slice (library-and-sources.md, inclusion-criteria-setup.md). Persisted at var/datasets/<id>/dataset.json. The canonical state is `criteria` (each a real column + a structured predicate) and `cohort`; `cohort_sql`, `count`, and each criterion's `sql`/`params`/`display` are DERIVED deterministically and re-derive identically on reload.

databases.description: The source database slugs this Dataset's filters touch.

criteria.description: The grounded inclusion criteria, ANDed over the cohort base.

not_available.description: Phrases that grounded to nothing structural (e.g. concepts only in free-text notes), surfaced honestly rather than invented (structured-only, v1).

cohort_sql.description: DERIVED: the read-only SELECT DISTINCT enumerating the slice's identities (the transparent raw-SQL view). Re-derived from criteria + cohort; never hand-authored.

count.description: DERIVED: COUNT(DISTINCT identity) over the cohort with the criteria applied, proved read-only at definition time.

database.description: The cohort base's home database (the main read-only connection; others ATTACH).

from.description: The joinable FROM clause the predicates qualify against.

identity_select.description: The identity projection, e.g. `b.patient_code AS patient_code`.

source.description: The real column, `<database> -> <table>.<column>`. Nothing is faked.

sql.description: DERIVED parameterised clause (value is always a bind).

value.description: Scalar for =/>=/<=/>/<; a list for `in`; a [lo, hi] pair for `between`. The stored code, never the word.
